title: Qualitative analysis and numerical investigations of time-fractional Zika virus model arising in population dynamics
summary: Epidemic models play a crucial role in population dynamics, offering valuable insights into disease transmission while aiding in epidemic prediction and control. In this paper, we analyze the mathematical model of the time-fractional Zika virus transmission for human and mosquito populations. The fractional derivative is considered in the Caputo sense of order $α\in(0,1).$ We begin by conducting a qualitative analysis using the stability theory of differential equations.
